resources.string: Sends an explicit BUY or SELL request to MetaTrader 5 after verifying XAUUSD, a fixed 0.01 lot, market-order mode, and one unambiguous action button. It cannot view other apps.
Use + BUY or − SELL while the XAUUSD order screen is visible.
Broker: Exness MT5 · Demo and real accounts supported
Start, prepare the XAUUSD market-order screen once, then use +/− here or from the notification. Each accepted + raises the yellow offset and submits one BUY; each − lowers it and submits one SELL.
Enable the MT5 gold automation Accessibility service first.
Enable the Accessibility service, then return here.
The Accessibility service is enabled but still connecting. Wait a moment and try again.
Ready. Tap Start to enable commands.
Active. Prepare XAUUSD in MT5, then use + BUY or − SELL.
Stopped. No new BUY or SELL request can run.
Enter an amount from 0.001 to 1000, with no more than three decimal places.
%1$s queued. Open the XAUUSD market-order screen in MT5.
%1$s button submitted for %2$s at %3$s lot. Confirm the position in MT5.
